
  [38;2;55;195;160m[1mfm schema object[0m
  [38;2;153;153;153mGenerate a structured output schema for an object type.[0m

  [38;2;55;195;160m[1mUSAGE[0m
    [38;2;153;153;153m%[0m fm schema object --name Person --string name --int age --description 'Age in years'
    [38;2;153;153;153m%[0m fm schema object --name Restaurant --string name --string address.street --string address.zip
    [38;2;153;153;153m%[0m fm schema object --name Restaurant --string title \
      --nested address --schema "$(fm schema object --name Address --string zipcode)"
    [38;2;153;153;153m%[0m fm schema object --name SearchResult --anyOf \
      --schema "$(fm schema object --name Found --string name)" \
      --schema "$(fm schema object --name NotFound --string reason)"

  [38;2;55;195;160m[1mOPTIONS[0m
    [1m-h, --help            [0mShow help information
    [1m--name <name>         [0mName of the root object type (required)

  [38;2;55;195;160m[1mPROPERTY DECLARATIONS[0m
    [1m--anyOf               [0mBuild an anyOf union; subsequent --schema args become choices
    [1m--boolean <name>      [0mDeclare a boolean property
    [1m--double <name>       [0mDeclare a floating-point property
    [1m--integer <name>      [0mDeclare an integer property
    [1m--object <name>       [0mDeclare a nested object property (follow with --schema)
    [1m--schema <json>       [0mProvide a structured output schema (after --object or --anyOf)
    [1m--string <name>       [0mDeclare a string property

  [38;2;55;195;160m[1mPROPERTY MODIFIERS[0m
    [1m--array               [0mMark the preceding property as an array of that type
    [1m--description <text>  [0mSet a description on the preceding property
    [1m--optional            [0mMark the preceding property as optional

  [3m[38;2;153;153;153mUse dot notation in property names (e.g. 'address.street') to create nested objects.[0m
